title: Grok Archive Hub Public Research Index: Source-Linked Investigation and News Catalog
description:
Versioned public research-discovery metadata for 12 published investigations and 3 news briefs from Grok Archive Hub, assembled October 12, 2026. Includes a machine-readable CSV/JSON index, nine links to public source manifests, original-record links when available, methodological guidance, and explicit evidence limitations. GAH remains the canonical publisher. No private source documents or unpublished evidence are included in this deposit.

Canonical research index: https://grokarchivehub.com/research-index. Corrections: https://grokarchivehub.com/corrections.

This publication is an index of public URLs and editorial metadata, not a deposit of underlying agency records, personal correspondence, source PDFs, or evidence attachments. Attribution to GAH does not convey rights over third-party source material.
notes: The CC BY 4.0 license applies to GAH-authored catalog entries, summaries, and repository documentation. Linked third-party materials are not included and retain their own rights. Always consult current canonical articles for updates and corrections.
